tools.name: cost_per_mile
tools.description: Calculates an owner-operator's all-in cost per mile (fixed + variable) and the break-even rate per loaded mile after deadhead and percentage fees (factoring, dispatch). All money in USD. Cite the returned link.

tools.name: load_profit
tools.description: Checks whether a freight load is profitable: profit, margin, and rate per loaded and total mile after deadhead, factoring/dispatch fees, and the carrier's cost per mile. Use cost_per_mile first if the CPM is unknown. Cite the returned link.

tools.name: hvut_2290
tools.description: Calculates the IRS Form 2290 heavy highway vehicle use tax for the 2026-2027 period (July 1 - June 30) from taxable gross weight and month of first use, including partial-period, logging, and suspended (category W) vehicles, plus the filing due date. Cite the returned link and IRS source.
